report_md:
## Vacancy assessment

**Verdict:** unknown (0.78 confidence). The current physical occupancy question is unresolved.

The strongest historical record is the 2019 MLS listing for 1234 10th St (listing 301868630), which called the property a level lot for new construction, showed zero bedrooms, and stated the lot was at 10th and Union. It closed on February 14, 2019. This supports vacant-lot status when marketed in early 2019, but does not establish the present condition. Zillow separately reports a June 27, 2019 public-record sale for $245,000; its generic multifamily label has no beds, baths, area, or build year and conflicts with the vacant-lot listing.

A 2026 City of Oakland planning attachment matches APN 004 003902100 to 1234 10th St but gives ZIP 94606, while the issue and 2019 listing use 94607. The attachment contains zoning and parcel-identification fields, not occupancy evidence. A public-record-derived LoopNet profile for the exact APN reports “Recreationalacreage” and a 0.07-acre lot, but this is not a site observation and does not establish whether a structure is present or occupied. No reliable post-2019 observation or record was found to establish whether the lot remains vacant.

**Start and duration:** The first located vacancy evidence is the 2019-01-16 listing. The actual vacancy onset and any continuous vacancy duration are unknown. The evidence supports vacant-lot status when marketed in early 2019 only; it does not support a claim of seven years of continuous vacancy.

**Sources:** [2019 MLS listing](https://www.realty.com/land-listings/284715846/1234-10th-St-Oakland-CA-94607); [Zillow property and sale history](https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/1234-10th-St-Oakland-CA-94607/299068138_zpid/); [Oakland planning attachment](https://oakland.legistar.com/View.ashx?GUID=DE9D9D0B-4771-4D9D-8F7E-B529062A531F&ID=15191265&M=F); [LoopNet property profile](https://www.loopnet.com/property/1234-e-10th-st-oakland-ca-94606/06001-004%20003902100/); [Oakland permit search guidance](https://www.oaklandca.gov/Planning-Building/Permit-Process-Overview/Permit-Services-Questions-Portal).
